comments.author: @TheLostHorizon1
comments.text: The eight thousand year claim isn't about grapes, it's about a method. Wine fermented in clay vessels buried underground, sealed and left through winter, and people still make it that way in home cellars. It's not the oldest wine in a museum sense, it's a technique that never stopped. Change my mind.
